posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Well, did you try giving a big offset to the buttons in the 'Extended Message Functionality' plugin settings? Or does that stretch the whole message box too?
If that does not work, you could toggle the visibility of the buttons off. Then show pictures of those commands there and attach common events to them. In the plugin settings of 'Extended Message Functionality/Message Core' declare what keyboard keys launch those button commands. Then in your picture common events make it so that the click registers as that keyboard press.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
In the plugin settings you can turn the buttons off. Plugin settings also allow you to set the keyboard keys. Show pictures are just event commands. VS Picture Common Events plugin allows you to attach common events to the pictures.
